hero.title: Building a Better Online Shopping Experience
hero.description: We are dedicated to creating a seamless e-commerce platform where customers can discover quality products, enjoy secure transactions, and receive exceptional service every step of the way.
hero.secondaryDescription: By combining technology, reliability, and customer-focused solutions, we help thousands of shoppers find exactly what they need with confidence.

story.title: Driven by Innovation and Customer Satisfaction
story.description: Founded with a vision to simplify online shopping, our platform connects customers with trusted products from reliable sellers. We continuously improve our services, technology, and logistics to deliver a shopping experience that is fast, secure, and enjoyable.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Our mission is to empower customers by providing access to high-quality products through an intuitive, transparent, and reliable digital marketplace. We strive to make every purchase simple, secure, and rewarding.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: We envision a future where online shopping is effortless, trustworthy, and accessible to everyone. Our goal is to become a leading global marketplace recognized for innovation, customer satisfaction, and long-term value.

customerFirst.title: Customer First

innovation.title: Continuous Innovation

trust.title: Trust & Transparency

fastDelivery.title: Fast Delivery

securePayments.title: Secure Payments

intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.text: We collect information you provide directly: name, email, phone number, and delivery address when you register or place an order. We also collect usage data automatically.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.text: We use your information to process orders, send updates, improve our services, and communicate with you about your account and purchases.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share it with trusted partners necessary to fulfill your orders (e.g. delivery services) or as required by law.

security.title: Data Security
security.text: We use industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access or disclosure.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at any time to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us via the contact page or email us directly.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

account.title: Account Responsibilities
account.text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

orders.title: Orders & Payments
orders.text: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation. We reserve the right to cancel any order and issue a full refund if a product becomes unavailable or a pricing error occurs.

delivery.title: Delivery & Shipping
delivery.text: We aim to deliver all orders within the estimated timeframe. Delivery times may vary depending on location. We are not responsible for delays caused by third-party carriers.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.text: You may return eligible items within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive the return.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Activities
prohibited.text: You may not use our platform for any unlawful purpose, to transmit harmful content, attempt to gain unauthorized access, or engage in any activity that disrupts our services.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.text: All content on this platform including logos, text, images, and software is owned by us or licensed to us. You may not reproduce or distribute any content without written permission.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.text: We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our platform. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for the order in question.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.text: We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. Continued use of our platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through our contact page or email us directly.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our platform.

orders.q: How do I place an order?
orders.a: Browse products, add them to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll need an account to complete your purchase.

orders.q: Can I modify or cancel my order?
orders.a: You can cancel or modify your order within 1 hour of placing it. After that, the order enters processing and cannot be changed.

orders.q: How do I track my order?
orders.a: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also view order status in your account under Orders.

delivery.a: Standard delivery takes 2–5 business days. Express delivery is available at checkout for next-day arrival in most areas.
Yes, we deliver across Georgia. Delivery times and fees may vary depending on your location.
Free delivery is available on orders over ₾199 within the Tbilisi area.

returns.a: You can return eligible items within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

returns.q: How do I start a return?
returns.a: Go to your Orders page, select the item you want to return, and follow the return instructions. Our team will arrange a pickup.

returns.q: When will I receive my refund?
returns.a: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.

account.q: How do I create an account?
account.a: Click Sign Up at the top of the page, enter your name, email, and password. You'll be ready to shop immediately.

account.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?
account.a: Click Forgot Password on the login page and enter your email. You'll receive a reset link within a few minutes.

account.q: How do I update my profile information?
account.a: Go to Account Settings from your profile menu. You can update your name, phone number, and password there.

payments.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards, as well as popular digital wallets. All transactions are secured with encryption.

payments.q: Is it safe to pay on your platform?
payments.a: Yes. We use industry-standard SSL encryption and trusted payment gateways to ensure your payment details are always protected.

payments.q: Can I get an invoice for my order?
payments.a: Yes, invoices are automatically generated for every order and available to download from your Orders page.
